what: This is a preferred share issued by Strategy, the company formerly called MicroStrategy, which holds bitcoin as its main asset and also sells enterprise analytics software. It pays a fixed dividend and ranks ahead of the ordinary shares.
customers: Enterprise software customers buy the analytics products; this security is sold to investors who want a high fixed payment with bitcoin behind it.
money: enterprise analytics licences and cloud subscriptions
bitcoin bought with money raised from securities like this one
moat: Strategy's advantage is access to capital markets at scale rather than any business moat; the software operation is small and bitcoin is available to everyone.
risks: The dividend depends on the company continuing to raise money or sell bitcoin
Large reported losses arise when bitcoin is written down
About $7 billion of debt ranks ahead of this security
A sustained fall in bitcoin would erode the asset cover behind the payment
opportunities: A very high fixed dividend rate compared with ordinary corporate payouts
Paid before ordinary shareholders receive anything
The company's bitcoin holdings currently exceed its debt and preferred obligations in value
watch: Bitcoin price against total debt and preferred obligations, and whether the dividend keeps being declared.
